fields.Name: Apollo - Get Lists
fields.Description: Lists the Apollo labels (lists and tags) with each one's kind. Run this to discover the exact list names the other Apollo list actions require.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Resolve the Apollo key from this company's Apollo credential instead of the environment. Optional — falls back to the APOLLO_API_KEY environment key.

fields.Name: Lists
fields.Description: Array of { id, name, kind, cachedCount, createdAt, updatedAt }.

fields.Name: Count
fields.Description: Number of labels returned.

fields.Name: KeySource
fields.Description: Which path supplied the API key: 'credential' or 'environment'. Present so a wrong-key failure is diagnosable without re-running.
Labels retrieved.
Listing Apollo labels failed. The message carries the Apollo error.
The Apollo credential resolved but its Values carry no usable apiKey.
No Apollo API key could be resolved for the supplied CompanyID or the environment.
A required input was absent. The message names the field.
An input was present but not usable. The message explains why.

fields.Name: Apollo - Create List
fields.Description: Creates an Apollo list (label) idempotently — an existing label with the same name is reused rather than duplicated, because Apollo will happily create two labels with one name.

fields.Name: ListName
fields.Description: The label to create. Required.

fields.Name: Modality
fields.Description: 'contacts' (default) or 'accounts' — Apollo rejects a mismatched modality on later use. Echoed back as an output carrying the modality the label actually has, which differs from the input when an existing label was reused.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Resolve the Apollo key from this company's Apollo credential instead of the environment. Optional — falls back to the APOLLO_API_KEY environment key.

fields.Name: ListID
fields.Description: The label's Apollo id.

fields.Name: ResolvedListName
fields.Description: The label name as Apollo stores it.

fields.Name: AlreadyExisted
fields.Description: True when an existing label was reused instead of a new one created.

fields.Name: KeySource
fields.Description: Which path supplied the API key: 'credential' or 'environment'. Present so a wrong-key failure is diagnosable without re-running.
Label created, or an existing one reused.
Creating the Apollo label failed. The message carries the Apollo error.
The Apollo credential resolved but its Values carry no usable apiKey.
No Apollo API key could be resolved for the supplied CompanyID or the environment.
A required input was absent. The message names the field.
An input was present but not usable. The message explains why.

fields.Name: Apollo - Search People
fields.Description: Searches Apollo's people database for net-new prospects by organization, title and seniority. Does NOT return emails or phones — that is Apollo's design for this endpoint. At least one filter should be supplied; Apollo accepts a request with none and returns an unhelpfully broad result.

fields.Name: OrganizationDomains
fields.Description: Company domains to search within, e.g. ["acme.com"].

fields.Name: OrganizationIDs
fields.Description: Apollo organization ids to search within.

fields.Name: Titles
fields.Description: Job titles, e.g. ["VP of Marketing"].

fields.Name: Seniorities
fields.Description: One or more of owner, founder, c_suite, vp, director, manager.

fields.Name: Page
fields.Description: 1-based page number.

fields.Name: PerPage
fields.Description: Records per page, max 100.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Resolve the Apollo key from this company's Apollo credential instead of the environment. Optional — falls back to the APOLLO_API_KEY environment key.

fields.Name: People
fields.Description: Matching people. No email or phone — see the description.

fields.Name: Pagination
fields.Description: Apollo's pagination envelope for this response.

fields.Name: Count
fields.Description: Number of people returned on this page.

fields.Name: KeySource
fields.Description: Which path supplied the API key: 'credential' or 'environment'. Present so a wrong-key failure is diagnosable without re-running.

fields.Name: Apollo - Move List Accounts
fields.Description: Moves accounts from one Apollo list to another. Labels are full-replace in Apollo, so the add is performed BEFORE the remove — a failed add can then never strip the source label. Reads page 1 of the source list only; ids not found there are reported in NotOnSourcePage rather than treated as failures.

fields.Name: AccountIDs
fields.Description: JSON array or comma-separated Apollo account ids. Required.

fields.Name: FromList
fields.Description: Exact source label name. Required.

fields.Name: ToList
fields.Description: Exact destination label name. Required.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Resolve the Apollo key from this company's Apollo credential instead of the environment. Optional — falls back to the APOLLO_API_KEY environment key.

fields.Name: MovedCount
fields.Description: Number of accounts confirmed moved.

fields.Name: FailedCount
fields.Description: Number whose write failed.

fields.Name: PossiblyStuckCount
fields.Description: Number whose write SUCCEEDED but which Apollo did not appear to honour. Not failures — Apollo silently ignores some removes.

fields.Name: Results
fields.Description: Per-record { id, added, removed, possiblyStuck, error }.

fields.Name: NotOnSourcePage
fields.Description: Supplied ids that were not on page 1 of the source list, and so were never attempted.

fields.Name: KeySource
fields.Description: Which path supplied the API key: 'credential' or 'environment'. Present so a wrong-key failure is diagnosable without re-running.
Every supplied id was moved.
Some ids moved and some did not. Read Results, FailedCount and NotOnSourcePage — a partial move is NOT rolled back.
None of the supplied ids were found on the source list.
FromList or ToList was not supplied.
The id list could not be parsed, or FromList and ToList are the same label.
The move failed. The message carries the Apollo error.
The Apollo credential resolved but its Values carry no usable apiKey.
No Apollo API key could be resolved for the supplied CompanyID or the environment.
